faq.q: How do you price a project?
faq.a: We read your requirements, ask questions where something is unclear, and send a fixed quote with the scope and timeline. If the scope changes later, we quote the change before doing it.

faq.q: What do you need from us to quote?
faq.a: A short description of the process you want, the Odoo version and edition you use (or plan to use), and any examples: a spreadsheet, a form you fill in today, or screenshots of the system you're replacing.

faq.q: Do we get the source code?
faq.a: Yes. Custom work is delivered as an Odoo module with its source code, so you can host it where you like and another developer can maintain it if needed.

faq.q: Can you work on Odoo.sh or Odoo Online?
faq.a: Custom modules run on Odoo.sh and on your own server. Odoo Online (the SaaS plan) doesn't accept custom modules, so for custom code you'd move to Odoo.sh or self-hosting.

faq.q: Do you work with companies in other countries?
faq.a: Yes. We work remotely with businesses in many countries, by email, chat and video calls, and plan meetings around your time zone.

faq.q: What does Modvanta do?
faq.a: Modvanta is a software company focused on Odoo. We publish ready-made Odoo apps on the Odoo Apps Store and build custom modules, integrations and complete systems for companies that run Odoo.

faq.q: Where can I buy your Odoo apps?
faq.a: Every app is sold on the official Odoo Apps Store. Each app page on this site links to its store page.

faq.q: Which Odoo versions and editions do your apps support?
faq.a: Our catalogue is built for Odoo 19. Each app page states whether it works with Community, Enterprise or both. We port apps to Odoo 17 and 18 on request.

faq.q: Can you customise an app for my company?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us what you need on top of an existing app and we reply with the scope and a fixed quote.

faq.q: How do I get support?
faq.a: Email modvantaapps@gmail.com with the app name, your Odoo version and the steps to reproduce the problem.

faq.q: Do I own the code you write for me?
faq.a: Yes. Code written for your project is delivered to you with its source, and you can keep it in your own repository.

faq.q: Which Odoo versions do you work with?
faq.a: Odoo 19 is our main version. We also build and port modules for Odoo 17 and 18 when a project needs it.

faq.q: Do you work with Community and Enterprise?
faq.a: Yes. We check which edition you run and build on the apps you already have.

faq.q: How do you price a custom module?
faq.a: Send us what the module must do. We review it, ask questions where needed and reply with the scope and a fixed quote before any work starts.

faq.q: Is there already a connector for the system I use?
faq.a: Check our app catalogue first. If it is not there, send us the API documentation of the system and we will tell you what can be synced.

faq.q: What happens when the other system is down?
faq.a: Our connectors log every call, retry where it is safe, and leave failed records visible in Odoo so nothing is lost silently.

faq.q: Can you extend one of your published connectors for us?
faq.a: Yes. Many projects start from a published connector with extra fields, rules or flows added for one client.

faq.q: Do you need our API keys?
faq.a: Only on your own database, entered by you or your administrator in Odoo settings. Keys stay in Odoo and are hidden from regular users.

faq.q: Can we try the system before we commit?
faq.a: Yes. We prepare a demo database with your scenarios so your team can test it before go-live.

faq.q: Do you host Odoo for us?
faq.a: We can deploy Odoo on a server you own or rent, with HTTPS and backups, so the data stays in your account.

faq.q: Can you work with our existing Odoo partner?
faq.a: Yes. We often build modules or integrations for companies that already run Odoo with another partner.

faq.q: Which languages can the system use?
faq.a: Odoo is multilingual. Our modules ship with translations where we have them, and we add the languages your users need.

faq.q: Which versions can you upgrade between?
faq.a: We port modules between Odoo 17, 18 and 19.

faq.q: Will our data be upgraded too?
faq.a: The database upgrade itself depends on your edition: Enterprise uses Odoo's upgrade service, Community uses the community migration scripts. We port your custom modules and test the upgraded database.

faq.q: How long does an upgrade take?
faq.a: It depends on how many custom modules you have. We give you an estimate after the module audit.

faq.q: Can we stay on our version and only fix problems?
faq.a: Yes. We also maintain modules on the version you run today.

faq.q: How does a migration from Odoo 18 to Odoo 19 work?
faq.a: We list every custom and third-party module, port the ones you still need, then upgrade a copy of your database and let your team test it. Only when the copy works do we plan the switch on your live system, with a backup taken just before.

faq.q: What changed in Odoo 19 that breaks custom modules?
faq.a: Some fields are gone, such as the mobile field on contacts and the pricelist field on websites. SQL constraints are now declared with models.Constraint instead of _sql_constraints, and parts of the website JavaScript API changed. Modules that relied on these fail to install or show errors until they are ported.

faq.q: Do you migrate third-party apps from the Odoo Apps Store?
faq.a: If the author already publishes a version for your target release, we use it. If not, we port the module ourselves where its licence allows it, or suggest a replacement.

faq.q: Is my country covered?
faq.a: Browse the localization apps. If your country or report is missing, send us the official specification and we will review it.

faq.q: Who is responsible for tax advice?
faq.a: Our modules implement published rules; your accountant stays responsible for tax advice and filings.

faq.q: What happens when rates change?
faq.a: Rates and thresholds are kept as dated records you can edit, and we update modules when rules change.

faq.q: Do the modules work with Odoo Community?
faq.a: Most do. Each app page says which editions and apps it needs.

faq.q: Do you support modules you did not write?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the module and a description of the problem; we review it before quoting.

faq.q: How do we report a problem?
faq.a: Email us the module, your Odoo version, the steps to reproduce and any error message or screenshot.

faq.q: Do you check security?
faq.a: Yes. We review routes, access rules, uploads, SQL and secret handling in the code we work on.

faq.q: Can you work on our server?
faq.a: We prefer to reproduce on a copy first, then deploy the fix with you.

faq.q: Do you build private Shopify apps for one store?
faq.a: Yes. A custom app is installed only on your store, and you get the source code.

faq.q: Can you move our old Shopify Scripts to Shopify Functions?
faq.a: Yes. Checkout, discount, payment and delivery rules can be rebuilt as Shopify Functions.

faq.q: Can you connect Shopify to Odoo?
faq.a: Yes. Our Shopify connector for Odoo syncs orders, products, customers, stock and refunds, and we adapt it to your process.

faq.q: How do I get a price?
faq.a: Describe what the store needs through the quote form. We reply with questions or a written scope and price.

faq.q: Which Magento versions do you support?
faq.a: Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce 2.4.x.

faq.q: Can you connect Magento to Odoo?
faq.a: Yes. Our Magento connector for Odoo syncs orders, products, customers, stock with MSI sources and credit memos.

faq.q: Where can I get support for a Modvanta extension?
faq.a: See the support page or email us with the extension name, versions and the steps to reproduce.

faq.q: Do you build custom Magento features?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us what the store needs and we reply with the scope and a quote.

faq.q: What kind of software do you build?
faq.a: Web applications, portals, mobile apps, APIs, integrations, dashboards and automation for businesses.

faq.q: Who owns the code?
faq.a: You do. The source code is delivered to your repository.

faq.q: Should we build custom software or use Odoo?
faq.a: If Odoo or an existing app covers most of the need, that is usually faster and cheaper. We tell you honestly when custom software is the better choice.

faq.q: How do I get a price?
faq.a: Send a short description of the problem through the quote form. We reply with questions or a written scope and price.

faq.q: Which AI models do you use?
faq.a: We build on Claude (Anthropic) or OpenAI's ChatGPT models, or any service with an OpenAI-compatible API. You can switch provider later without rebuilding the bot.

faq.q: Will the chatbot make things up?
faq.a: It answers from the content you give it: products, prices, FAQ and policy pages, plus live data from your system. When it can't find an answer it says so and passes the chat to a person. No AI is perfect, so we test the bot with your real customer questions before it goes live.

faq.q: What does it cost to run?
faq.a: The AI usage is billed to your own API key, so you pay the provider directly and only for what is used. We set a monthly budget cap and rate limits, so a spike in traffic or a spammer can't run up the bill.

faq.q: Do I need Odoo?
faq.a: No. We build chatbots for any website, Shopify store or custom system. If you run Odoo, the bot can read live prices, stock and order status and add leads to your CRM.

faq.q: Can the bot work on WhatsApp?
faq.a: Yes. We build WhatsApp bots that take orders, answer questions and send updates, connected to your orders in Odoo or in your own system.

faq.q: Is our data safe?
faq.a: Your data stays in your system. Only the text needed to answer a question goes to the AI provider you choose. Bots get read-only access unless you decide otherwise, and every action is logged.

faq.q: Who owns the chatbot?
faq.a: You do. Custom work is delivered with its source code, and it runs on your server or your Odoo.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: A website chatbot based on our ready-made Odoo app can be live in a few days. A custom bot with integrations usually takes a few weeks. The quote gives you the exact timeline before work starts.
